items.title: The Hidden Trade-Offs of Urban Cooling
items.topic: cities using trees, reflective roofs, shade structures, and water features to reduce extreme heat
items.topicJa: 樹木や反射屋根、日陰、水を使って猛暑を和らげる都市政策
items.benefit: cooler streets can reduce health risks, energy demand, and discomfort during heat waves
items.benefitJa: 熱波時の健康リスクや電力需要、不快感を減らせること
items.challenge: different cooling methods require land, water, maintenance, money, and long-term planning, and their benefits are not distributed automatically
items.challengeJa: 方法ごとに土地、水、維持費、資金、長期計画が必要で利益も自動的に公平にはならないこと
items.lesson: climate adaptation should be judged by effectiveness, durability, and who actually receives protection
items.lessonJa: 気候適応策は効果、持続性、誰が実際に守られるかで評価すべき

items.title: When Transparency Creates More Confusion
items.topic: the assumption that publishing more information always makes institutions easier to understand
items.topicJa: 情報公開を増やせば組織が必ず分かりやすくなるという考え
items.benefit: open records can expose errors, support accountability, and allow independent analysis
items.benefitJa: 公開記録は誤りを明らかにし説明責任や独立した分析を支えられること
items.challenge: large volumes of technical or poorly organized information can overwhelm readers and shift advantage toward people with more time and expertise
items.challengeJa: 大量で専門的または整理不足の情報は読者を圧倒し時間や専門知識のある人を有利にすること
items.lesson: meaningful transparency requires accessible structure and context, not disclosure alone
items.lessonJa: 意味ある透明性には公開だけでなく理解しやすい構造と文脈が必要

items.title: The Problem of Designing for the Average User
items.topic: public services and products designed around statistical averages
items.topicJa: 統計的な平均を基準に公共サービスや製品を設計する問題
items.benefit: average measurements can simplify planning and help designers create workable standards for large populations
items.benefitJa: 平均値は計画を単純化し大人数向けの実用的な基準を作る助けになること
items.challenge: few individuals are average in every relevant dimension, so a design that fits the average may exclude many real users
items.challengeJa: すべての面で平均的な人は少なく平均向け設計が多くの実際の利用者を排除する可能性があること
items.lesson: flexible ranges and diverse testing often serve populations better than a single idealized user
items.lessonJa: 一人の理想的利用者より柔軟な範囲と多様な検証の方が多くの人に役立つ

items.title: Why Resilient Supply Chains Look Inefficient
items.topic: companies balancing low everyday costs against the ability to survive disruptions
items.topicJa: 日常コストの低さと混乱への耐久力を両立させる供給網
items.benefit: lean inventories and concentrated suppliers can lower storage costs and simplify ordinary operations
items.benefitJa: 在庫を絞り供給先を集中すると保管費を下げ通常業務を単純化できること
items.challenge: a single disaster, conflict, transport failure, or factory closure can then interrupt the whole system
items.challengeJa: 災害、紛争、輸送障害、工場停止が一つ起きただけで全体が止まりうること
items.lesson: some duplication and spare capacity may appear wasteful in normal times but function as insurance against rare shocks
items.lessonJa: 重複や余力は平時には無駄に見えてもまれな危機への保険になる
